headline: the 125.9 MB full-system STEP imports, saves, and cold-reopens intact in FreeCAD 1.1.3 on this machine. The mechanical stage is no longer hostage to SolidWorks.

FC0_toolchain.screenshot_note: freecadcmd is headless; recorded as not-captured rather than silently skipped. GUI screenshots deferred to FC10.

toolchain_defects_found_and_fixed.symptom: FC00 exited 0 having executed nothing - a silent no-op that looked like success
toolchain_defects_found_and_fixed.how_caught: verified the receipt files were absent rather than trusting exit code 0
toolchain_defects_found_and_fixed.fix: 04_scripts/FC_RUN.py launcher sets __name__, tees output to 99_logs, records the true exit code and any traceback
toolchain_defects_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: without this, every subsequent FreeCAD script would appear to pass while doing nothing

toolchain_defects_found_and_fixed.defect: freecadcmd swallows stdout/stderr and returns 0 on exception
toolchain_defects_found_and_fixed.fix: same launcher; every run now leaves a .log and a _RUN.json receipt

FC2_import.verdict_plain_language: import SUCCEEDED; the FAIL is my gate refusing to pass 6 invalid solids, which is the correct fail-closed behaviour
FC2_import.resource_conclusion: a 125.9 MB / 457-solid STEP costs under 1% additional commit on this machine. The single-document route is resource-viable.

brep_health_finding.occ_diagnosis: Self-intersecting wire + Unorientable shape on every one
brep_health_finding.conclusion: these are genuine topological defects carried inside the source STEP, not import artifacts

structure_is_3_identical_pairs_not_6_unr.inference: one defective part type instanced three times, each paired with a second defective part. Pairs B and C sit at mirrored off-axis positions, consistent with left/right solar-array hinge or wing-root hardware.
structure_is_3_identical_pairs_not_6_unr.identity_status: UNRESOLVED_COMPONENT_IDENTITY - not guessed. Formal identity resolution is FC2 section 2 work using STEP names, V5/V4 manifests, BOM and interface coordinates.

brep_health_finding.disposition: carried as an explicit HOLD. NOT deleted, NOT silently passed, NOT merged into any other interference class. Excluded from the collision model until resolved.
brep_health_finding.why_this_does_not_block_the_baseline: 451 of 457 solids are valid and the round trip is bit-exact. The affected bodies are localised and identifiable, so downstream work can proceed with an explicit exclusion list rather than stopping.

route_decision.rationale: 457 solids import in 78 s, save to a 53.9 MB FCStd, and cold-reopen with zero volume delta at ~81% commit. The subsystem App::Link split remains the documented fallback but is not needed.
route_decision.note: the script emitted recommended_route=SUBSYSTEM_APP_LINK_SPLIT purely because its ok-flag requires invalid_shape_count==0; that is a health gate, not a resource verdict. Recording both so the discrepancy is not hidden.

process_governance.termination_method: targeted CIM filter on CAE-Agent-Hub / comsol_link / Aerospace_MCP_Skills / codex_skill command lines

mcp_status.reason: owner ruling allows MCP to be HOLD and mandates that script mode continue regardless. FC0-FC2 were completed entirely through FreeCADCmd + versioned project scripts, which is the authoritative path.
mcp_status.planned: neka-nat/freecad-mcp pinned to a recorded commit, RPC bound to 127.0.0.1, no auto-start, only_text_feedback preferred

next_automatic_action: FC2 section 2 - component identity resolution across the 457 objects using STEP names, V5/V4 manifests, BOM, bounding boxes, centres of mass and interface coordinates, then FC3 operational assembly construction
